run_relax_atoms: run a geometry relaxation on ASE atoms using the FIRE optimizer with a force convergence threshold
run_relax_atoms_with_symmetry: run a geometry relaxation on ASE atoms with symmetry constraints fixed during optimization
run_relax_atoms_with_cell_filter: run a geometry relaxation on ASE atoms using a cell filter to relax unit cell parameters
run_relax_atoms_with_observers: run a geometry relaxation on ASE atoms with callback observers attached at specified intervals
run_relax_atoms_custom_optimizer: run a geometry relaxation on ASE atoms using a custom ASE optimizer class instead of FIRE
